{{Top|leg}}
A '''para-foil''' was a type of [[Parachute/Legends|parachute]] attached to [[Ejector seat/Legends|ejector seats]]. The [[Guidenhauser/Legends|Guidenhauser]] seats fitted to [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] were fitted with para-foils for [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] descent.
